subject: ReadySet passoff: NimbleCare implementation coordination
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Jordan Woods <jordan.woods@nimblecare.com>, Procurement <procurement@nimblecare.com>
Date: 2027-05-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: ReadySet passoff: NimbleCare implementation coordination

Hi Marissa / Tessa —

Putting NimbleCare into your hands after the exec sign-off. Quick background: NimbleCare procured Dedicated capacity (2x A100-equivalent) with a go-live target of 2027-07-15. Deal ID RDW-2027-0743. Highlights you should know:

- Primary use case: live patient triage and clinician triage automation (high concurrency, many short requests).
- Data residency: US-only, VPC peering required; customer will use their own KMS.
- SLA: 99.9% per contract, with a 200ms p50 target on their primary route.
- Integrations: they will call the Redwood API from an internal service behind a NAT; they plan to use streaming chat for clinician workflows.

Attached the latest SOW (v3) and a rough implementation plan from Presales. Important asks for CS/Implementation:
1) Confirm CS owner and primary POC for kick-off by EOD Friday (2027-05-21).
2) Review the attached implementation plan and flag any sequencing or capacity issues — especially around DB migration and KMS config.
3) Recommend whether we should schedule a pre-kickoff technical sync with Infra (they requested an Ops lead).

Jordan — feel free to add anything I missed.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
attachments: NimbleCare_SOW_v3.pdf, MAL-implementation-plan.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Jordan Woods <jordan.woods@nimblecare.com>
Date: 2027-05-19T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ReadySet passoff: NimbleCare implementation coordination

Thanks Karthik — looping in Tessa as Implementation lead. Marking this as high priority for May/June runway. Quick responses up front, then a short plan: 

1) CS ownership: Primary CS owner = Marissa Cole (cc'd). Implementation lead = Tessa Morgan. I'll own the post-go-live adoption and success metrics.

2) Kickoff asks / open questions we need answered before sprint planning:
- Can procurement confirm who will be our technical POC and a contact for KMS access windows? (Procurement / Jordan)
- Do they require SOC 2 artifacts prior to environment handover? We have a standard package but need to know timing.
- Expected daily QPS pattern — the attached plan assumes bursty mornings (08:00–11:00 PT) and steady background traffic. If incorrect, please share telemetry.

3) Proposed next steps (my recommendation):
- Internal pre-kickoff (Redwood infra + CS + AE): 2027-05-24, 11:00–11:45 PT. Goal: confirm network/KMS/entitlement gating.
- Customer kickoff (all parties): 2027-05-27, 10:00–11:30 PT. Agenda draft: introductions, SOW review, success criteria, security checklist, timeline.
- Sprint0 window suggestion: 2027-06-01 -> 2027-06-14 (staging + acceptance).

Attachments: I'll upload a trimmed implementation checklist to the folder after this message.

Action items for Karthik: please confirm the Ops contact and whether NimbleCare requires a DocuSign redline to SOW v3.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Perfect — thanks Marissa.

Confirmation from my side:
- Ops contact: Erin Park (erin.park@nimblecare.com) — has VPN admin and KMS liaison rights.
- Procurement: they have requested a single minor SOW redline (section 4.2 on acceptance windows). I'll route that to legal and DocuSign today; expect their signature by 2027-05-21.

I'll book the internal pre-kickoff for 05/24 and send calendar invites to the thread.

Karthik
AE, Redwood Inference
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-19T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: NimbleCare handoff — risk & priority notes

Marissa / Tessa — quick internal note after reading the plan:

- Priority risk: KMS handover timing. If Erin cannot grant staged KMS access for staging before formal signature, we need a fallback for testing (mock KMS + redaction). Please prepare an abbreviated test plan that avoids production keys.
- Performance target (200ms p50) is aggressive for their concurrency pattern; schedule a perf-run in staging with 80% of expected QPS to validate kernel selection and batching. Ask Runtime team for a short-run quota to emulate concurrency spikes.
- Escalation path: for any SLA drift during sprint0, escalate to me -> Head of Infra (Vivek Kulkarni) -> Legal if acceptance windows are impacted.

I'll join the internal pre-kickoff on 05/24. If you want, I'll lead the first customer kickoff to signal priority.

Rafael Mendes | Director, Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
